label: Custodial Interrogation Was Not Recorded (Stephan)
motion_heading: {client}'s Statements Must Be Suppressed Because the Custodial Interrogation Was Not Recorded

review_conditions.display_note: You aren't sure yet whether your client was in custody. This section was drafted anyway; pin down whether your client was under arrest or restrained like an arrest (handcuffs, locked car, told not free to leave) before filing, or cut this section.

sentences.text: A custodial interrogation conducted in a place of detention must be electronically recorded when recording is feasible.
An unexcused failure to record requires suppression of the unrecorded statements.

_author_notes: Alaska-only issue added at the maintainer's request (Stephan). Both statements were written from general knowledge and have no authorities: Alaska citations aren't covered by the Supreme Court citation policy. Unverified; add Stephan and later cases, and check that the statements (feasibility, the remedy, and whether suppression is limited to the unrecorded portion) match Alaska law.
